entities.name: Durga Malla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Major Dūrgā Malla was the first Gorkha soldier of the Indian Gorkhas in Indian National Army (INA) to sacrifice his life to the cause of Indian independence. Malla belonged to Newar community of the Gorkhas.
